title: Immolate
summary: IM'MOLATE, verb transitive [Latin immolo, to sacrifice; in and mola, meal sprinkled with salt, which was thrown on the head of the victim.] 1. To sacrifice; to kill, as a victim offered in sacrifice.

inlines.v: IM'MOLATE, verb transitive [Latin immolo, to sacrifice; in and mola, meal sprinkled with salt, which was thrown on the head of the victim.] 1. To sacrifice; to kill, as a victim offered in sacrifice. 2. To offer in sacrifice. Now immolate the tongues and mix the wine.
